0022600024.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-2, 1-0 at home, 0-2 on the road, on a one-game losing streak) host the Denver Nuggets (2-2, on a one-game winning streak) in the Suns' fourth game of the 2026-27 season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game. Phoenix is 3rd in the Pacific and 11th in the West, while Denver is 4th in the Northwest and 9th in the West. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix with a shoulder injury (surgery), and Oso Ighodaro is day-to-day with an oblique strain and is a game-time decision. Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (personal), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season series the Suns lost 0-3, including a 125-123 loss in Phoenix on March 24, 2026.
